blueprint_reuse.effect_scope: These P0/P1 tests were run against the approved-source mechanics; reuse unchanged Oracle interactions only, not their candidate hashes or a full gameplay performance verdict.

candidate_D_existing_executed_tests.actual_scope: Exact D 100, real payable four-land sequence, three old Pirate attackers and source-paid commander, negative theft controls, retained engines
Skyship/Malcolm existing-counter trigger order, conditional free cast, boast cost and resource sacrifices, Departed spell target weakness

effect_coverage_cases.fixture: Underground Sea on T1, Volcanic Island T2, Badlands T3, City T4; pay each spell's real cost, commander precombat, three older distinct Pirates all deal combat damage to same opponent, legal nonland theft target at endstep
effect_coverage_cases.assertion_and_result: Bounded executed PASS: four available lands pay commander {1}{U}{B}{R}; City deals one damage on tapping; three older source Pirates can cause an endstep theft trigger if undeterred
effect_coverage_cases.adverse: Fog, no target, fewer than three distinct hits, or commander absent at trigger time prevents the tested result
effect_coverage_cases.residual_limitation: One conditional ordered exact draw/board; ignores opening-hand frequency, stack wars and broad opposing card interactions.

effect_coverage_cases.fixture: Both Pirates deal combat damage; Malcolm already has two chorus counters; controller determines simultaneous trigger order, Skyship targets Malcolm
effect_coverage_cases.assertion_and_result: Bounded executed PASS: Skyship-first makes Malcolm reach four during its own trigger and permits conditional free cast of actually discarded card; Malcolm-first reaches four too late for the same trigger. At zero counters Plunderer cannot create a new kind.
effect_coverage_cases.adverse: Skyship must hit and its target/counter kinds must remain eligible; no guaranteed fourth-counter cast from merely drawing Malcolm
effect_coverage_cases.residual_limitation: Does not sample appearance or survival of both two-card synergies in real opponents' games.

effect_coverage_cases.fixture: Broadside has attacked and has an available other artifact; separate choice of Treasure token MV0 and Signet MV2 for boast cost
effect_coverage_cases.assertion_and_result: Bounded executed PASS: Treasure means 2 damage, insufficient to kill 3-toughness defender; Signet means 4 damage but irreversibly consumes the ramp artifact; boast cannot activate before attacking or twice per turn
effect_coverage_cases.adverse: Double blockers can block menace and there may be no surplus artifact/creature after casting commander
effect_coverage_cases.residual_limitation: No full combat stack, target-responses, treasure generation frequency or total sacrificed-resource utility model.

effect_coverage_cases.fixture: Deckhand is evasive against ordinary non-Spirit blockers without paying Saboteur's {2}{U}; opponent has a targeted spell or Spirit blocker
effect_coverage_cases.assertion_and_result: Bounded executed PASS: spell targeting Deckhand sacrifices it; equipment's equip activated ability is not a spell; printed Spirit exception remains
effect_coverage_cases.adverse: Deckhand can be blocked by Spirit bodies; gives up repeatable loot and is weak to own targeted spells
effect_coverage_cases.residual_limitation: No measurement of opposing Spirit/removal density or value of discarded/drawn cards.

effect_coverage_cases.fixture: Three ready D Pirates versus two ground non-Spirit blockers, then individually versus flying/reach/Spirit blockers; compare three baseline non-evasive bodies without Saboteur mana
effect_coverage_cases.assertion_and_result: Finite adversarial unit asserts D can put through three distinct sources against the two ground bodies while baseline's three ground sources yield at most one; a single flyer, reach creature, or Spirit can reduce D to two and deny trigger
effect_coverage_cases.adverse: Ground attackers can gain evasion from other spells, Saboteur can pay {2}{U}, and opposing blocker assignments/time differ by board
effect_coverage_cases.residual_limitation: Specific ready-board blocking states; not random hand generation, opponent blocker prevalence or measured connection probability.

effect_coverage_cases.fixture: Three opponents at 40 life, Forerunner stays alive across three of own turn's Daring Piracy Pirate-token entries, all token combat may be blocked
effect_coverage_cases.assertion_and_result: Finite Oracle and arithmetic assert opponent life goes 40 to 37 each (nine aggregate loss), without any qualifying Pirate combat damage; Forerunner's Pirate tutor places revealed card on TOP of deck, not in hand
effect_coverage_cases.adverse: D forfeits genuine repeat incremental noncombat clock and topdeck selection; Broadside only gives faster haste/menace and expensive conditional boast
effect_coverage_cases.residual_limitation: Assumes Forerunner survives; doesn't model chosen tutor target, multiplayer turns of survival or relative conditional value.

effect_coverage_cases.fixture: Two-mana flyer comparing a {1}{B} flash, deathtouch Pirate that can target a different already-attacking Pirate on entry
effect_coverage_cases.assertion_and_result: Finite Oracle comparison asserts Poisoner's instant-speed blocking/trade role is lost; cannot retroactively attack from being flashed after attackers; Skyship instead advances damage over ground defenders but is blocked by flyers/reach
effect_coverage_cases.adverse: Fast creature pressure or flyers makes Poisoner's defense preferable; nonflier blocker-heavy tables favor Skyship
effect_coverage_cases.residual_limitation: Strategic matchup conditional; no simulated meta composition or hidden instant responses.

effect_coverage_cases.fixture: Land #4 is needed to cast Admiral precombat on turn four; available colored requirement is {U}{B}{R} plus {1}
effect_coverage_cases.assertion_and_result: Previously executed source-paid line includes City as untapped fourth mana and its triggered self-damage; always-tapped Crumbling would be unusable that landing turn
effect_coverage_cases.adverse: Repeated City taps each deal one to controller, trading attrition life for tempo; no blanket reliability improvement is measured
effect_coverage_cases.residual_limitation: One specific constrained land sequence; not a full color-source frequency proof or City self-damage survival probability.

decision_grade_judgment.why_D_preferred_for_commander_first_stra: Beckett rewards three distinct Pirates connecting to one player and stays only Bracket 4, not generic Grixis goodstuff. D makes cheap unassisted evasion and haste available earlier while retaining Merchant Raiders, The Indomitable and Open into Wonder. The 5 real replacements are defensible over a whole-deck audit but have acknowledged adverse table profiles.
decision_grade_judgment.strongest_counterargument: Removing Forerunner gives up top-of-library tribal tutoring and significant repeated Daring Piracy entry-drain; removing Poisoner removes instant-speed deathtouch and attacking Pirate combat trick. Opponent flyers/Spirits and removal can stop D just as effectively as a ground-stalled incumbent configuration.
decision_grade_judgment.reason_for_no_large_simulation: One falsifiable cost/timing blocker issue per cluster is resolved by the existing source-paid and finite adverse fixtures. No effect-complete matched multiplayer model or precommitted decision-changing endpoint presently justifies another costly simulation; a generic proxy would be biased toward flyers and ignore Forerunner token drain and Poisoner trade.
decision_grade_judgment.what_could_reverse_choice: Evidence that Forerunner's surviving multi-turn tutor/drain materially wins more games than Broadside's conditional third-connection haste; a local meta dominated by reach/flyers/Spirit blockers or creature aggro could favor poisoner/other evasion packages. Report as matchup-dependent, not a proven replacement superiority.
